name: optcatalog_deactivate_trail_runtime_state
description: OptCatalog::DeactivateTrailRuntimeState stops trail resources, unlinks a trail runtime state from its owner list, disables active trail nodes, and resets the active slot cursor.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass; the native smoke avoids live light/effect/sound providers and focuses on the source-visible list and active-node side effects.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aefb0 validates optional stop-handle, stop-sample, trail-effect, and light cleanup, doubly-linked active trail runtime unlinking, active owner-head update, active node-slot deactivation, cursor reset, and constant zero return.

The native smoke verifies a middle runtime state is unlinked from its owner list, owner activeTrailRuntime advances to the next state, the runtime next/prev pointers are cleared, populated active node slots are disabled, the active slot cursor is reset, and the function returns zero.
